meta.description: Singapore's trusted beauty and wellness booking platform. Scan, book, pay in seconds.

home.subtitle: Discover top salons, spas, and wellness studios. Scan a QR code at the shop, choose your service, pay securely - no app required.
home.flowSubtitle: From discovery to confirmed booking - the whole flow takes under five minutes.
home.discoverDesc: Browse hundreds of salons and wellness studios across Singapore.
home.chooseDesc: Pick a service, date, and time that works for you.
home.payGoDesc: Secure Stripe payment - confirmation lands in your inbox instantly.
home.qrBookingDesc: Walk in, scan the merchant's QR code, pick a service, and pay - all in under 60 seconds. No app, no hardware needed.
home.scanDesc: Point your phone camera at the merchant's QR code - no download needed.
home.bookDesc: Choose your service and a time slot that fits your schedule.
home.dealFallback: Book this approved merchant deal before it ends.
home.topMerchantsSub: Handpicked salons and wellness studios from our marketplace.

notifications.bookingConfirmedCustomer: Payment received. Your {{service}} booking at {{merchant}} is confirmed for {{when}}. See you there.

reschedule.title: Reschedule Booking
reschedule.subtitle: Choose a new date and time for your appointment.

assistantReplies.replyError: Assistant could not reply right now.
assistantReplies.cancel: Hi {{name}}, you can cancel an eligible booking from My Bookings. Open View bookings, choose the booking, then select Cancel. If the merchant has a cancellation policy, the app will check it before cancelling.
assistantReplies.reschedule: Hi {{name}}, you can reschedule from My Bookings. Pick the booking, select Reschedule, then choose a new available date and time.
assistantReplies.payment: Hi {{name}}, pending bookings can be paid from the checkout page or from My Bookings. Once payment succeeds, I will send a confirmation here automatically.
assistantReplies.confirm: Hi {{name}}, confirmed bookings appear in My Bookings after payment is completed. I also send a confirmation message here when payment succeeds.
assistantReplies.booking: Hi {{name}}, you can view all your appointments from View bookings. I will also message you here when bookings are created, confirmed, cancelled, or rescheduled.
assistantReplies.loyalty: Hi {{name}}, open Wallet to view loyalty points, vouchers, and recent reward activity. Paid bookings can earn loyalty points automatically.
assistantReplies.merchant: Hi {{name}}, merchant users can manage services, availability, promotions, staff, and bookings from the merchant dashboard after approval.
assistantReplies.help: Hi {{name}}, I can help with booking, payment, cancellation, rescheduling, loyalty wallet, and account questions.
assistantReplies.fallback: Hi {{name}}, I can help with booking, payment, cancellation, rescheduling, loyalty wallet, and account questions. Try asking something like "How do I cancel my booking?"
